column3: Close to the Hebrew; the plural “your Creators” (plural of majesty) is rendered “your Creator,” and “days of evil” “the difficult days.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reads the feminine “grinders” and “those that look” without marking gender.
Close to the Hebrew; “daughters of song” is rendered “daughters of music.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the caper-berry fails” is rendered “desire fails,” and “house of perpetuity” “eternal home.”
NKJV supplies “Remember your Creator” to resume the sentence from v. 1.
Close to the Hebrew; “Qoheleth” is rendered “the Preacher,” and “futility” “vanity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “words of delight” is rendered “acceptable words.”
Close to the Hebrew; “masters of collections” is rendered “the words of scholars,” and “one Shepherd” is capitalized.
Close to the Hebrew; “more than them” is rendered “by these.”
Close to the Hebrew; “everything has been heard” is rendered “Let us hear,” and “this is all man” “this is man’s all.”
